name: SAPRES
recent: SAPRES 近期出现董事 Dato' Shahriman bin Shamsuddin 的持股终止申报，并有一项清盘 / 接管 / 限制令 / 特别管理相关的公告。公司也发布了截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日止期间的季度业绩，以及一份谅解备忘录公告。
notable: 董事 Dato' Shahriman bin Shamsuddin 提交持股终止申报（Section 139 of CA 2016）。

risks: 出现清盘 / 接管 / 限制令 / 特别管理相关公告，需留意后续发展。
董事 Dato' Shahriman bin Shamsuddin 持股终止申报，涉及股权变动。

recent_en: SAPRES recently saw a notice of ceasing to be a substantial shareholder by Director Dato' Shahriman bin Shamsuddin, along with an announcement on winding up / receiver and manager / restraining order / special administrator. The company also released quarterly results for the period ended 31 July 2026 and a memorandum of understanding announcement.
notable_en: Director Dato' Shahriman bin Shamsuddin filed a notice of ceasing to be a substantial shareholder (Section 139 of CA 2016).
The company made an announcement relating to winding up / receiver and manager / restraining order / special administrator.
The company entered into a memorandum of understanding.
risks_en: An announcement on winding up / receiver and manager / restraining order / special administrator was made; further developments should be monitored.
Director Dato' Shahriman bin Shamsuddin filed a notice of ceasing to be a substantial shareholder, involving a change in shareholding.
